_doc: Data-driven rules for studio_rules_hook.ps1. Add a rule = add one object, then run sync.bat (no hook code). Fields: id; event (UserPromptSubmit | PreToolUse | PostToolUse | Stop); match (regex on the diacritics-stripped lowercase prompt, or on tool name + file path for tool events); inject (text added to the agent context); flag (state flag to set); once (inject only once per session). Special rule ids: correction (detects owner corrections and arms the retro gate), retro_gate (Stop: blocks finishing until skills/AGENTS/digest changed and published).

rules.match: toi da bao|toi bao|toi noi roi|lan sau|luon luon phai|sao lai|van bi|lai bi|van chua|chua dung|chua ngon|sai roi|i told you|you keep|stop doing|again and again
rules.inject: OWNER CORRECTION / STANDING RULE DETECTED. Do all of this in THIS session without being asked: (1) log it in docs/owner-requests.md; (2) fix the work; (3) turn the rule into the strongest enforceable form: update the matching skill in Unity-AI-Instructions/skills, add a line to STUDIO-BRAIN-DIGEST.md and AGENTS.md if it is a standing rule, and if it is checkable add or extend an audit tool / a rule in studio_rules.json (a hook beats prose); (4) run publish.bat; (5) tell the owner in one line what was upgraded. The Stop gate will block finishing until the skills repo changed.

rules.match: chiet xuat|tinh tuy|extract the essence|extract skill|cap nhat skill|update skill|upgrade skill|viet skill
rules.inject: SKILL EXTRACTION ORDER: write GENERIC skills (no game, popup or class names of one project), short, with `Use when ...` description under 300 chars and `triggers:` incl. Vietnamese without accents; merge near-duplicates; put measured numbers and script templates in the skill folder; run publish.bat and report one line.

rules.inject: AUTOMATION GAP DETECTED: the owner is doing manually something the studio must do by itself. Do not answer with prose. Build the automation now: a rule in studio_rules.json, a hook, an audit script, a scheduled loop or a skill trigger; prove it with a dry run (pipe a sample event into the hook) and publish.

rules.match: tham khao|hoc hoi|tinh hoa|reference project|break and steal|break an egg|knife tower|monkey.escape|bouncesdk|sketch sdk|asset store|pack nay|lay nguyen|copy y|clone
rules.inject: REFERENCE LEARNING ORDER: use superpowers. Spawn read-only study subagents (one per topic, docs/reference-<project>/*-STUDY.md with file:line evidence), evaluate harshly with a scorecard (licence first for packs), write a plan with rulings (docs/superpowers/plans), port the ESSENCE into our own layer (SketchSdk, UI kit, skills) via Codex briefs + director verification, regenerate art in our style, then extract generic skills and publish. Skill: reference-project-dissection (Learning loop).

rules.match: gen.*(texture|icon|button|sprite|art|anh)|codex.*(art|ui|gen)|image gen|9 ?slice|outline|bo goc|nut ui|texture ui|art ui|icon|outline|vien|shadow|bong do|9 ?slice|screenshot|anh chup|nhin xau|ban mat|lech|de len|mat text
rules.inject: UI ART RULE: load skills ui-art-quality-gate, codex-ui-sprite-brief and ui-sprite-audit. Every art brief to Codex carries the rules block (image_generation only, exact rounded rect, constant thick outline, corner-cap 9-slice, <=512 px, no clipping). Run ui-sprite-audit/sprite_audit.py on every output before import; any FAIL = rework with the numbers. Importer manifest (ppu/border) overrides .meta. Look at an 8x corner crop and an in-game screenshot at real size. Never import an unverified batch. Icons: ui-icon-outline-bake (thick uniform outline baked, ledger). Replace whole families at once; read AGENTS.md section UI ART PIPELINE. Owner screenshot or 'looks wrong' => load ui-screenshot-defect-analysis and print the defect table first; run family_audit.py after plate changes.

rules.match: textmesh|text mesh|tmp|textmeshpro|font sdf|alpha clip|chu bi|vet den|outline chu|shader chu
rules.inject: TEXTMESHPRO RULE: load skill tmp-shader-alpha-clip-fix (and tmp-font-optimization). Ensure the TMP_SDF shaders carry the clamped alpha clip (max(alphaClip..., 0.01)); keep the guard test green; change one text suspect at a time and zoom-check in Play. EVERY TMP (UGUI and world) must have an outlined material and no black smear/halo: if you see a text without outline or with a dark haze (hard underlay, outline >= 0.7, dilate >= 0.5), fix it at the shared material/prefab yourself, no project C# tool, no asking (skill ui-text-tmp).

SWALLOW GUARD: if this edit sets a feature/UI flag to false (const bool X_ENABLED = false, ENABLED = false, hidden 'until reworked'), add an OPEN row to docs/owner-requests.md in the SAME change naming the flag and the rework, or the owner's task is silently swallowed. Also never close a task on 'code exists': prove it is live in Play (bound, tappable, visible).

CURRENCY BAR: load skill ui-currency-bar-contract BEFORE editing. Icon centre on the frame's LEFT EDGE (overhangs, covers the bar edge), never inside the frame; one shared builder/prefab; keep a test that fails when the icon sits inside; screenshot every place the bar appears.

rules.inject: OWNER: a matching skill exists and was not applied. Find it now (skills/INDEX.md / router), load it, redo the work by its contract, add an enforceable check (test/audit/hook) so it cannot be skipped again, then publish.

rules.match: knife tower|speed keyboard|speedkeyboard|giong y chang|100% nhu|che linh tinh|ref chuan|nhu knife
rules.inject: NO INVENTION: Knife Tower Speed Keyboard is the owner's hand-written 100% reference (code style, structure, UI). Read its prefab YAML/scripts directly (read-only), list EVERY KT element (sprites, fonts, sizes, positions, which screen holds which button, e.g. Shop/Skins entry), reproduce exactly, add and move nothing. Your report MUST contain a KT-vs-ours element diff table and a Play capture next to the KT reference; otherwise REWORK. Skill: ui-exact-clone-workflow (NO-INVENTION LAW).

ORIENTATION RULE: read the project's orientation (AGENTS.md / ProjectSettings) first. Glass Together is LANDSCAPE ONLY: never design, build, capture or QA portrait layouts; use 16:9, 19.5:9, 20:9. If a tool or builder would set portrait, stop and fix it. Guard: EditMode test Orientation_Landscape_Tests.

rules.match: rut kinh nghiem|luu pattern|luu lai pattern|save this pattern|capture this pattern|learn from this mistake|learn from this bug|luu loi nay|tao lint rule|lint rule
rules.inject: CAPTURE PATTERN: follow skill capture-pattern-with-lint in this session: (1) short skill skills/<name>/SKILL.md, (2) tools/lint/rules/<name>.py whose message points to .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, (3) bad/good fixtures + pytest tools/lint/tests (RED first), run python tools/lint/run_lint.py on the bad fixture to prove it fires, (4) publish.bat. Do not ask; decide and record a Ruling.

CORE-FLOW FIRST: Before expanding optional SDK, monetization, or polish, establish the active game's natural critical journey from its GDD/reference. Require uninterrupted Play evidence for boot, meaningful input/feedback, repeatable core content, earned progression, application/placement where applicable, resumed play, win/next, and save/reload. Seeded wallets, forced completion, and synthetic tests help isolate logic but do not prove the end-to-end path. Record starting conditions and each transition/state in docs/reports/core-flow-evidence.md; mark a milestone not applicable only with a game-specific reason. If the core path is blocked, return the plan to it first.

rules.match: mobile input|touch|tap|short press|press edge|waspressedthisframe|coalesced|finger id|fingerid|gesture|joystick|input system|cam cham|cham ngan|nut bam|cham man hinh|ngon tay
rules.inject: MOBILE ACTION INPUT: Keep discrete taps distinct from held/repeated actions. Consume a down/press edge as well as held state so down+up within one input update is not lost; preserve the same touch identity and UI-vs-world exclusion. Require a coalesced down+up test (one command, then zero on the next input update), a hold-semantics check, and real short-device-gesture evidence when available. Synthetic tests are not device proof.
